description.value: El Cartel is a Mexican street food restaurant housed in the lower level of the AMS Nest at UBC, born from a food truck run by an international team of chefs drawing on culinary traditions from Mexico, Korea, India, Ireland, and Vietnam. The menu features handmade corn tortilla tacos, burritos, and rice bowls with inventive fusions like Korean Bulgogi Steak Tacos alongside classic Beef Birria. It serves the UBC campus community with fresh, fast street food and also offers catering for events.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (20 spaces, covered) at 24m; stands (10 spaces, covered) at 41m. Total: 30 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms El Cartel is a real, operating Mexican street food restaurant inside the AMS Nest at UBC (Lower Level, 6133 University Blvd), consistent with OSM address and unit LL-104. The menu explicitly lists vegetarian taco and veggie bowl options, and the site describes pickup as a catering service option while framing the concept as fast street food for quick bites. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM tags or on the website.

OSM tags the business as a restaurant (amenity=restaurant) but the website prominently identifies it as a food truck concept that moved into a food court; the OSM tag is acceptable but the in-building food court context may affect expectations around table seating vs. counter service.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant operating inside the UBC AMS Nest with a live website, consistent address, and clear menu — a practical food stop for cyclists riding through the UBC campus.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Ensenada Vegetarian Tacos (black beans, corn, onions, roasted garlic, pico de gallo) and Ensenada Veggie burrito/bowl (chickpea, herb-infused olive oil, fresh vegetables)
